meta.name: launch
meta.description: When the user wants to plan a product launch, feature announcement, or release strategy. Also use when the user mentions 'launch,' 'Product Hunt,' 'feature release,' 'announcement,' 'go-to-market,' 'beta launch,' 'early access,' 'waitlist,' 'product update,' 'how do I launch this,' 'launch checklist,' 'GTM plan,' or 'we're about to ship.' Use this whenever someone is preparing to release something publicly. For ongoing marketing after launch, see marketing-ideas. For the offer being launched (bonuses, guarantees, scarcity, naming), see offers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划产品发布与上市策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正计划公开推出产品或功能
copy.tagline_en: Plan your product launch and go-to-market strategy.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're preparing to publicly launch a product or feature.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扮演产品发布顾问。它先检查是否有产品营销背景文件，再带你按自有/租用/借用三类渠道（ORB框架）、五阶段发布流程来规划，并给出发布清单、Product Hunt 打法与发布后营销建议。
howto.when: 当你说要规划产品发布、功能公告或发布策略，或提到“launch”“Product Hunt”“go-to-market”等关键词，或表示“准备上线/发布”时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个产品发布计划，下月上线。
say.note: 它会给出分阶段发布流程和清单。

say.text: 我们要上 Product Hunt，给个完整打法。
say.note: 它会给出发布前中后的具体策略。

say.text: 用 ORB 框架规划这次功能发布的渠道。
say.note: 它会按自有/租用/借用渠道分别给方案。
